row.evidence: ClickUp's pricing page lists 'SAML SSO & SCIM Provisioning' under Enterprise (Contact sales), and the help centre says Okta SSO, Microsoft SSO and custom SAML, which SCIM requires, are Enterprise-only.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Plans on the pricing page: Free Forever, Unlimited $7 (yearly; $10 monthly), Business $12 (yearly; $19 monthly), Enterprise (contact sales). Business Plus no longer appears on the pricing page (the API rate-limit doc still lists it), and June's '~$20-45/u/mo' Enterprise estimate had no first-party source, so it is dropped. Google SSO on Business is Sign in with Google, not SAML, so sso_plan is Enterprise. SCIM needs Okta SSO or custom SAML enabled first; the Okta OIN app provisions (create, update, deactivate, group push as Teams), Entra needs a non-gallery custom SAML app because the gallery app does not support SCIM, JumpCloud's connector provisions users but not groups. Deactivation keeps the user as an 'inactive user'. Workspace user-management endpoints (invite, get, edit, remove user, audit logs) are Enterprise-only; the rest of the API is on every plan.

plans.name: Free Forever
plans.notes: General API available (100 requests/minute); user-management endpoints Enterprise only.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Google SSO (Sign in with Google) only; not SAML.

auth.token_source: Settings > Security & Permissions: SCIM Base URL and SCIM API Token shown after SSO (Okta or custom SAML) is enabled
auth.notes: Entra guide pastes the SCIM API Token into the Secret Token field; the header scheme is not stated.

deprovision.data_retained: User is removed from the Workspace and can no longer access it, but their data remains as an 'inactive user'; SCIM responses return only the deactivated status.

custom.how: ClickUp extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:ClickUp:2.0:User with role (2 admin, 3 member, 4 guest, 100 limited member, or custom role id), customRoleId, customRoleName; region is also listed (gradual release).

roles.how: ClickUp Role attribute in Okta; urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:ClickUp:2.0:User:role (constant or expression mapping from Entra app roles); custom roles via customRoleId/customRoleName.

rate_limits.text: Bulk profile pushes can hit rate limiting; Okta retries automatically after 60 seconds. No numeric SCIM limit published.

limitations.text: Entra gallery app (ClickUp Productivity Platform) does not support SCIM or group provisioning; a custom non-gallery SAML app is required.
Group provisioning creates new Teams only; it cannot link to existing Teams, nested groups are not supported, and each user can have only one app role.
No import of users or groups from ClickUp into Okta.
JumpCloud connector does not support SCIM Groups.

endpoints.purpose: Edit User On Workspace: name and role (Enterprise)
Query Workspace-level audit logs (Enterprise, owner only)

rate_limits.text: Per token, by Workspace plan: 100 requests/minute on Free Forever, Unlimited and Business; 10,000/minute on Enterprise (pricing page).

limitations.text: Invite, get, edit and remove user endpoints are Enterprise-only.

okta.notes: OIN page markup checks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO only; SCIM works only through a custom non-gallery SAML app.

open_questions: SCIM base URL, version and auth header scheme are not shown publicly (the URL and token appear in Security & Permissions after SSO is set up).
Whether SCIM deactivation frees the paid seat or ends active sessions is not documented.
Whether SCIM supports hard delete, filtering or pagination is not documented.
No list-workspace-users endpoint was found in the user API reference (Get Authorized Workspaces returns members).
ClickUp webhooks list no user events; not stated explicitly.
Google Workspace and OneLogin catalogue apps not checked; Google SSO is Sign in with Google.
